name: NOAA CO-OPS Data API
purpose: Primary station-level observations and tide/current predictions for water level, currents, water temperature, air temperature, wind, pressure, visibility and related coastal conditions.

name: NOAA CO-OPS Metadata API
purpose: Station discovery and metadata including coordinates, sensors, datums, harmonic constituents, flood thresholds and station capabilities.

name: San Francisco Bay Operational Forecast System (SFBOFS)
purpose: High-resolution Bay model guidance for water levels, currents, water temperature and salinity, including spatial nowcast and forecast guidance out to 48 hours.
mode: Primary model guidance via NOAA OFS / NetCDF adapters
role: Bay circulation and short-range forecast model
caveat: NOAA currently advises caution with North Bay salinity output for periods after June 2025 because of a boundary-forcing error tied to an upstream Sacramento River USGS station.

name: NOAA Operational Forecast Systems on AWS
purpose: Machine-scale access to current and historical NOAA OFS model files, including NetCDF products used for model extraction, archiving and spatial analysis.
mode: Primary bulk model feed via public S3
role: Bulk OFS model ingestion and archive

name: NOAA CO-OPS THREDDS
purpose: Access and subset Operational Forecast System NetCDF datasets through OPeNDAP-compatible services.
role: NetCDF model subsetting and archive access

name: NOAA CO-OPS ERDDAP
purpose: Standardized subsetting of observational water-level, meteorological and ancillary datasets in JSON, CSV, NetCDF and other formats.

name: NOAA nowCOAST
purpose: GIS visualization and map-service overlays for real-time coastal observations, forecasts, advisories, radar, sea-surface temperature, bathymetry and ocean-model guidance.

name: NOAA CO-OPS IOOS Sensor Observation Service (SOS)
purpose: Standards-based retrieval of recent and historical observations by station, station collection or geographic bounds.

name: NOAA CO-OPS SOAP / Axis Services
purpose: Legacy SOAP web-service access to CO-OPS observations and products.
role: Legacy compatibility; do not build new core ingestion around this service

name: NOAA CO-OPS Station Listings and Map
purpose: Human-facing station discovery, sensor-status review and validation of available coastal observations.
mode: Reference and QA; metadata should come from MDAPI

name: National Weather Service
purpose: Forecasts, wind, marine advisories, watches, warnings and weather hazards.

name: USGS Water Data OGC API — Continuous / Instantaneous Values (IV)
purpose: High-frequency observed river and water-quality measurements used for current freshwater forcing, flow, stage, temperature, conductivity, salinity and other available parameters.

name: USGS Water Data OGC API — Latest Continuous
purpose: Most recent observation from each continuous time series; preferred for efficient current-condition refreshes rather than downloading a full recent time window.

name: USGS Water Data OGC API — Daily Values (DV)
purpose: Daily mean, minimum, maximum and other statistic-coded values derived from continuous measurements; used for trend baselines, anomalies, recent history and seasonal context.
role: Daily hydrologic history and baseline comparison

name: USGS Water Data OGC Metadata
purpose: Monitoring-location, time-series, parameter-code and statistic-code metadata used to interpret USGS observations, units, period of record and provenance.

name: California Department of Fish and Wildlife
purpose: Regulations, seasons, report cards, species and access information.

name: RICHFISH Master Database
purpose: Spot profiles, species, condition logic, publications, source provenance and editorial controls.

name: Community and social reports
purpose: Recent observations, bait presence and catch reports used only as a corroborated local signal.
mode: Unverified signal requiring moderation and corroboration
role: Local signal; never overrides controlling sources
